Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a property tax exemption for the administrative offices of certain nonprofit organizations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a property tax exemption for the administrativeoffices of certain nonprofit organizations; and adding a new section tochapter 84.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The real and personal property owned by a community orneighborhood nonprofit organization providing charitable low andmoderateincome housing programs is exempt from taxation if theproperty is used primarily as an administrative office by theorganization. The department of revenue shall provide rules regardingadministrative offices exempt under this section, consistent with thepurposes of this section. The benefit of the exemption must inure tothe user. (2) For the purposes of this section, "community or neighborhoodnonprofit organization" means: (a) An organization exempt under 26 U.S.C. Sec. 501(c)(3) of theinternal revenue code of 1986; and p. 1 SHB 2675 (b) A community-based development organization or a communityhousing development organization, as defined by the United Statesdepartment of housing and urban development, certified by a state orlocal jurisdiction.
